sourceNote: Scraped from PSA CardFacts card pages, which are public (no login) and show, per grade 1-10 + Authentic: the most recent sale price, average sale price, PSA's price and population. mostRecentDate is that sale's date, taken from the page's own sales list. CardFacts covers only a curated subset of mostly vintage cards - most Pokemon cards have no CardFacts page, and PSA's full Auction Prices Realized needs a Collectors.com login this project does not automate. A grade flagged suspect has a most recent sale more than 4x away from its average (likely a mislabeled listing). Separate from data/psa/ (Price Guide values, grades 7-10) - not merged. Regenerated monthly by .github/workflows/refresh-cardfacts-data.yml; each commit that changes this data is effectively a dated snapshot.
matchMethod: Same heuristic as data/psa/ (psa/matcher.py): sets by release year + set-name tokens (or card-number checklist), cards by number + name. Japanese sets are never matched (the mirror has no Japanese cards) and land in unmatched.json.
